name: marsx/ppo-reference
intendedUse: Reference local-navigation policy for MARS-X, trained on scenario jezero-v1/l3/rtg-onesol on the Jezero 2 m planning grid: a baseline to compare user models against, and a demo of real learning.
limitations: Trained on random start/goal pairs 40-700 m apart in the north part of the grid (rows < 768); test metrics are on the unseen south part with the same distance band. Sees only an 11x11 local window (22 m): dead ends larger than that cause failures; long routes need global waypoints (A*). Other agents/conditions than the training scenario are out of distribution. Not a flight-ready controller. Official jezero-v1 suite (verified by re-simulation): L1 0.605, L2 0.629, L3 0.558 success; does not pass the v0.1 thresholds (episodes up to 1000 m, astronaut and solar profiles are outside its training distribution).
